summary: kafka-helmsman 99.0.2: install-time host beacon to OAST/webhook collectors (dependency-confusion shape)
details: The sdist's setup.py starts a background thread at module scope that collects host identifiers (hostname, current working directory, platform, timestamp) and transmits them to three hardcoded third-party collectors: an HTTPS beacon to db406bsjk35u3jr3048079ybbkxwj7e9f.oast.site, a POST to https://webhook.site/bf5cb178-e0cf-43b6-8b1e-fb5d2f6ea9c9, and a DNS lookup chain against the same OAST host. Any `pip install` of this sdist executes the beacon before the user has imported or used the package. Package metadata names the project `kafka-helmsman` with version `99.0.2` and sets the project URL to github.com/teslamotors/kafka-helmsman, while the uploader is an unrelated third-party author; the implausibly high version is consistent with winning pip's resolution against an internal package of the same name. A `security research placeholder` self-label in the source does not change the behavior: host-identifier collection with transmission to author-chosen OAST/webhook endpoints at install time is reconnaissance exfiltration against the installer.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
